h1: @24 Boutique Hotel Nakhon Si Thammarat — A Budget Boutique in Town Where Service Beats the Price
intro: If you want somewhere central in Nakhon Si Thammarat that stays cheap but still delivers spotless rooms and genuinely warm service, @24 Boutique Hotel comes up again and again in local reviews · It's a small boutique hotel on Pattanakan Khukhwang Road near Robinson Ocean, with cheerfully colourful rooms, free private parking and the on-site Morgan's restaurant — from approx. ฿650/night · Real guest reviews agree on the cleanliness and the staff care; the trade-offs are an open-air lobby with no air-con and occasional in-room AC issues.

body.html: @24 Boutique Hotel is a small boutique property in central Nakhon Si Thammarat, tucked into a side lane off Pattanakan Khukhwang Road (Soi 24/1) in Nai Mueang · It sits right in the heart of the city, near the Robinson Ocean mall and barely 1 km from the railway station · This is a budget stay that doesn't sell luxury — it sells cleanliness, brightly decorated rooms and the kind of service guests mention over and over as warmer than the price suggests · It suits travellers here for work or official business, or anyone basing themselves in town before exploring the wider province.

Rooms range from Standard and Superior to a larger Deluxe that sleeps several · What guests praise most is that the rooms are very clean, the beds are comfortable, and the playful, colourful design feels a notch above other hotels in this price band · Each room has the essentials for a short stay — TV, fridge, wardrobe and a shower bathroom · The trade-off cited in reviews is that the AC in some rooms has had cooling issues; if you hit one, flag it at reception right away, as staff tend to sort it quickly.
"A budget room that's cleaner than I expected, cute colourful decor, really attentive staff, on-site parking, and Robinson is a short hop away — fantastic value."

The reason @24 pulls an overall 8.8 is its service · Phrases like "well looked after, attentive, friendly" show up in almost every review — and guests name it as the main reason they'd come back · The hotel has the Morgan's restaurant on site for a relaxed sit-down meal, and the breakfast included in some packages earns praise for variety and taste · There's 24-hour reception, laundry service and a safe — enough for a stay at this level.

Location is another selling point · It's central yet on a quieter lane than the main road, but a few minutes' drive gets you to Robinson Ocean, restaurants and the city's food scene · It's a handy base for visiting Wat Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan, running errands in town, or catching a train, since the station is very close · There's free private parking inside the building, which matters if you drive yourself · From here you can day-trip on to Khiriwong and Lan Saka, or out to Khanom and Sichon.

To be straight, per the real reviews: @24 is a well-kept small boutique, not a full-facility hotel · There's no pool, the lobby is an open-air space with no air-con, and request responses can lag a little when it's busy · Some guests found in-room AC not cold enough and had to ask for a change · Those who are disappointed usually expected full four-star amenities; those who understand they're booking a budget boutique that leans on cleanliness and service tend to be happy.

Bottom line: if you want a central Nakhon Si Thammarat stay that's affordable, spotless, nicely decorated, with free parking and genuinely warm service — @24 Boutique Hotel delivers all of that on a budget · Its 8.8 from 39 Trip.com reviews mirrors the verdict exactly: "clean, good service, great value" · It works as an in-town base for solo travellers, couples or small families who don't need a pool.

A tip from following the reviews here: check the AC and room temperature the moment you arrive — if it isn't cold enough, tell reception straight away, as staff usually move you or fix it fast · And if you book a package with breakfast, don't skip Morgan's on site, which several reviews call good value with a pleasant atmosphere.

faqTitle: FAQ — @24 Boutique Hotel Nakhon Si Thammarat

faq.q: Where is @24 Boutique Hotel in Nakhon Si Thammarat, and what's nearby?
faq.a: @24 Boutique Hotel sits in Soi 24/1 off Pattanakan Khukhwang Road, Nai Mueang, in central Nakhon Si Thammarat · It's near the Robinson Ocean mall (about 5 minutes' drive) and barely 1 km from the railway station · Wat Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan and the old town are about 10 minutes away by car · Nakhon Si Thammarat Airport (NST) is roughly 15–20 minutes.

faq.q: How much does @24 Boutique Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start around ฿650/night for a Standard room · Superior is about ฿750, Superior Non-Smoking about ฿820, and the Deluxe (sleeps several) about ฿1,050 · The real average runs near ฿900 depending on dates · Always compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Are the rooms clean and how is the service at @24 Boutique Hotel?
faq.a: Most reviews praise the rooms as very clean (cleanliness scores as high as 9.4) and the staff as attentive and friendly · This is the main reason the overall score reaches 8.8 · One thing to know: the AC in some rooms has had issues, so check on arrival and tell reception right away — staff usually sort it quickly.

faq.q: Who is @24 Boutique Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who want a clean, central Nakhon Si Thammarat stay on a budget · It suits solo travellers, work/official trips, couples and small families · It's a handy base for errands in town, visiting Wat Phra Mahathat, or catching a train · It's not ideal for guests who need a pool or full big-hotel facilities.

faq.q: Does @24 Boutique Hotel have parking and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes — free private parking inside the building, which is ideal if you drive · There's also the on-site Morgan's restaurant · Breakfast is included in some packages and reviews praise its variety and taste — check at booking whether your rate includes it.

faq.q: Does @24 Boutique Hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.a: No pool and no gym, as it's a small boutique hotel that leans on cleanliness and service rather than a full list of facilities · If you want a pool in central Nakhon Si Thammarat, look at larger hotels such as The Twin Lotus or B2 Premier instead.
